findings.claim: The plan omits a required repository-level gate pass before archiving/commit readiness, so downstream execution may finish phase artifacts without proving the mini repo constraints still pass.
findings.evidence: Project constraints list blocking gates `build-passes` (`npm run check`), `tests-pass` (`npm test`), and `specs-valid` (`npm run spec:validate`) as preventing archiving until resolved. The plan's final section says only: "Plan-only checks: latest managed refresh; strict OpenSpec3changes; eleven backend-task↔assignment↔canonical identities; valid source/link/argv scopes; fresh artifact reviewer/screen; unchanged inspected product hashes and named product paths" and later "Commit only reviewed phase/OpenSpec Plan intake artifacts locally..."; it never schedules `npm run check` or `npm test` for the mini repo before archiving/commit readiness.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit validation step before archive/commit handoff to run and record `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run spec:validate`, or state any approved exception if a gate is intentionally deferred.
